items.docs:
This endpoint provides a list of all the custom attribute definitions within an organization.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

This endpoint allows you to create a definition for a custom attribute.
        It enables you to define a custom attribute, specify which data source types/objects it should
        apply to (such as Redshift tables), and fill in the business definition.
        This creates a comprehensive definition and identifies its applications.

**Required Role:** Data Manager or higher

If you have a GUID, this endpoint will return the information for a single custom attribute.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

If you possess a GUID for a custom attribute, this endpoint allows you to modify its details,
                such as its name and the objects it's assigned to.

**Required Role:** Data Manager or higher
